finding: _armor_context originally occupied ActionIntent.parameters, but strict existing brokers reject undeclared payload keys. This failed closed rather than bypassing policy, but prevented correct broker composition.
repair: Armor evaluates the original intent, then strips _armor_context before both adapter preflight and handler. The original ActionIntent remains unchanged for policy evaluation and request identity.
claim_ceiling: Strict-broker compatibility is established for the tested composition pattern; complete external-effect routing coverage remains unproven.
